description: Returns one diamond from VYKA's diamond inventory by its certificate (report) number or VYKA stone code (VYK-…), with the details its page on vykadiamonds.com shows: grades, measurements, AED price (plus an indicative currency), photo, its page link and the laboratory's report-check link. Use this when the user gives a report number or VYK code, or to re-check a stone from search_diamonds before they decide or contact VYKA. Limits: only stones VYKA currently lists can be found. found is false when VYKA does not list that number now (it may have sold, or VYKA may never have listed it); that says nothing about whether the report is genuine, and report_check_links then gives the laboratory's own check. It does not verify the report itself.

code.description: A GIA or IGI report number (e.g. 2141438171) or a VYKA stone code (e.g. VYK-I-612345678).

currency.description: Currency for the indicative price beside the AED price.

name: get_diamond

code.description: The report number that was looked up.

diamonds.description: Usually one; more when two laboratories used the same number.

cut.description: Cut grade, only where the issuing laboratory grades cut on this shape (IGI: all shapes; GIA: round only).

cut_note.description: Why no cut grade is shown, when there is none.

returnable.description: Whether VYKA's returns apply to this stone; null when not stated.

has_360.description: True when the stone's page shows a 360° view.

id.description: VYKA's stone code, as shown on the website (VYK-<lab letter>-<report number>).

indicative_price.description: The AED price shown in another currency, rounded up to the next 10 as the website does. Indicative only: checkout is in AED.

lab.description: Grading laboratory; null when the stone has no laboratory report.

link.description: The stone on vykadiamonds.com, where it can be viewed and bought.

marks.description: The website's notes on the stone, e.g. Eye-clean, No tinge, Non-returnable.

photo_url.description: This stone's own photo, and the only image to show for it. Images from a web search show other stones. A 360° capture can catch a round stone at a slight angle; the shape field and the measurements are the authority.

price_aed.description: The price in AED exactly as vykadiamonds.com shows it; this is the amount charged.

report_check_url.description: The laboratory's own report-check page for this report.

video_360_url.description: A direct 360° video file when the stone has one; otherwise the 360° view is on the stone's page.

scale.description: Which scale: natural and lab-grown scores do not compare.

report_check_links.description: Only when found is false: the laboratory report-check pages this number's format fits. The links are only built, not opened.

title: Get one VYKA diamond
